## Overview

This document verifies that the refactored functions produce results
consistent with the original implementations.

**Part 1:** Verify `co.tse()` and `wbg.boot.tse()` match originals\
**Part 2:** Verify `wbg.boot.test.tse()` (parallel) matches
`wbg.boot.tse()`

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Part 1: Verify co.tse and wbg.boot.tse

## 1. Verify co.wge() and co.tse() produce identical results

Minor refactor of co.wge(), just verifying it works the same...

```{r co-comparison}
# Generate test data
set.seed(42)
x_test = gen.arma.wge(100, phi = c(0.9), plot = FALSE, sn = 42)

# Run both functions
result_old = co.wge(x_test, maxp = 5)
result_new = co.tse(x_test, maxp = 5, ar_method = "burg")

# Compare all outputs
cat("=== Cochrane-Orcutt Comparison ===\n\n")

cat("b0hat match:", all.equal(result_old$b0hat, result_new$b0hat), "\n")
cat("b1hat match:", all.equal(result_old$b1hat, result_new$b1hat), "\n")
cat("z.order match:", result_old$z.order == result_new$z.order, "\n")
cat("z.phi match:", all.equal(result_old$z.phi, result_new$z.phi), "\n")
cat("pvalue match:", all.equal(result_old$pvalue, result_new$pvalue), "\n")
cat("tco match:", all.equal(result_old$tco, result_new$tco), "\n")
cat("z.x match:", all.equal(result_old$z.x, result_new$z.x), "\n")

# Overall check
all_match = all(

  all.equal(result_old$b0hat, result_new$b0hat) == TRUE,
  all.equal(result_old$b1hat, result_new$b1hat) == TRUE,
  result_old$z.order == result_new$z.order,
  all.equal(result_old$z.phi, result_new$z.phi) == TRUE,
  all.equal(result_old$pvalue, result_new$pvalue) == TRUE,
  all.equal(result_old$tco, result_new$tco) == TRUE
)

cat("\n*** ALL CO OUTPUTS MATCH:", all_match, "***\n")
```

## 2. Verify wbg.boot.wge() and wbg.boot.tse() consistency

The end goal was to write a flexible function that could do the WGB
boostrap test with any statistic and also in parallel. To do so, and
verify consistent results, needed to take a few steps.

1.  Keep the original wbg.boot.wge() logic, but modify to handle passing
    in our own seeds.
2.  To this effect, wrote wbg.boot.tse() and verified it produces the
    same results as wbg.boot.wge().
3.  Once quality is established, use it to compare to a parallel
    implementation.

### 2a. Verify identical results with legacy_seed = TRUE

```{r boot-comparison, cache=TRUE}
# Use same test data
nb_test = 99  # smaller for speed

# Run both with same sn - use legacy_seed for identical comparison
result_boot_old = wbg.boot.wge(x_test, nb = nb_test, maxp = 5, sn = 123)
result_boot_new = wbg.boot.tse(x_test, nb = nb_test, maxp = 5, sn = 123, 
                               legacy_seed = TRUE, ar_method = "burg")

cat("=== Bootstrap Comparison (legacy_seed = TRUE) ===\n\n")

cat("Old (wbg.boot.wge):\n")
cat("  AR order (p):", result_boot_old$p, "\n")
cat("  phi:", result_boot_old$phi, "\n")
cat("  p-value:", result_boot_old$pv, "\n\n")

cat("New (wbg.boot.tse):\n")
cat("  AR order (p):", result_boot_new$p, "\n")
cat("  phi:", result_boot_new$phi, "\n")
cat("  t-statistic:", result_boot_new$tco, "\n")
cat("  p-value:", result_boot_new$pv, "\n\n")

# All should match exactly
cat("--- Comparison ---\n")
cat("AR order (p) match:", result_boot_old$p == result_boot_new$p, "\n")
cat("phi match:", all.equal(result_boot_old$phi, result_boot_new$phi), "\n")
cat("p-value match:", all.equal(result_boot_old$pv, result_boot_new$pv), "\n")

boot_match = all(
  result_boot_old$p == result_boot_new$p,
  isTRUE(all.equal(result_boot_old$phi, result_boot_new$phi)),
  isTRUE(all.equal(result_boot_old$pv, result_boot_new$pv))
)

cat("\n*** ALL BOOTSTRAP OUTPUTS MATCH:", boot_match, "***\n")
```

### 2b. Confirm modern mode produces different (but valid) results

Modern and legacy mode won't produce the same results because of seed
differences, but they should be close.

```{r boot-modern-mode}
cat("=== Modern vs Legacy Seeding ===\n\n")

# Same sn, but modern mode (default)
result_modern = wbg.boot.tse(x_test, nb = nb_test, maxp = 5, sn = 123, 
                             legacy_seed = FALSE, ar_method = "burg")

cat("Legacy mode p-value:", result_boot_new$pv, "\n")
cat("Modern mode p-value:", result_modern$pv, "\n")
cat("P-values differ (expected):", result_boot_new$pv != result_modern$pv, "\n")
cat("Modern mode returns boot_seeds:", !is.null(result_modern$boot_seeds), "\n")
cat("Legacy mode returns boot_seeds:", !is.null(result_boot_new$boot_seeds), "\n")
```

### 2c. Verify wbg.boot.tse() reproducibility via boot_seeds

Verify that we can reproduce runs if given boot_seeds from a previous
run.

```{r boot-reproducibility}
cat("=== wbg.boot.tse Reproducibility ===\n\n")

# Run once and capture seeds
run1 = wbg.boot.tse(x_test, nb = nb_test, maxp = 5, sn = 456)

# Reproduce using returned boot_seeds
run2 = wbg.boot.tse(x_test, nb = nb_test, maxp = 5, boot_seeds = run1$boot_seeds)

cat("p-value run1:", run1$pv, "\n")
cat("p-value run2:", run2$pv, "\n")
cat("t-statistic run1:", run1$tco, "\n")
cat("t-statistic run2:", run2$tco, "\n")

cat("\n*** REPRODUCIBLE VIA boot_seeds:", 
    identical(run1$pv, run2$pv) && identical(run1$tco, run2$tco), "***\n")
```

### 2d. Verify boot_seeds length validation

Function will fail if boot_seeds is not the same length.

```{r boot-validation, error=TRUE}
cat("=== boot_seeds Validation ===\n\n")

# This should error - wrong length
tryCatch({
  bad_result = wbg.boot.tse(x_test, nb = 99, boot_seeds = 1:50)
  cat("ERROR: Should have thrown an error!\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Correctly caught error:\n")
  cat(conditionMessage(e), "\n")
})
```

# Part 2: Verify wbg.boot.tse vs wbg.boot.test.tse (Parallel)

This section verifies that the new parallel-capable
`wbg.boot.test.tse()` produces results consistent with `wbg.boot.tse()`.

The wbg.boot.test.tse() function can now be tested against the
wbg.boot.tse(). Notable differences below, but largely they are passing
in a function that generates a statistic to bootstrap, an adjust to
p-value calculation such that it can never be 0, and attempting the
bootstrap adjustment. More work to verify that code later in simulation
studies.

## Key Differences to Account For

| Aspect    | wbg.boot.tse()                | wbg.boot.test.tse()       |
|-----------|-------------------------------|---------------------------|
| Statistic | Hardcoded CO t-stat           | Flexible via `stat_fn`    |
| P-value   | `mean(abs(boot) >= abs(obs))` | `(sum(...) + 1)/(nb + 1)` |
| COBA      | Not implemented               | Available via `bootadj`   |
| Parallel  | No                            | Yes                       |

## 3. Create matching stat_fn

Many different stat generators in stat.generators.tse.R. All in the form
make.stat.\*.tse. Others need to be tested for validity.

```{r stat-fn}
# Create stat_fn using helper (or inline)
stat_fn <- make.stat.co.tse(maxp = 5)

# Verify it matches direct co.tse call
cat("Test stat_fn output:", stat_fn(x_test), "\n")
cat("Direct co.tse output:", co.tse(x_test, maxp = 5)$tco, "\n")
cat("Match:", stat_fn(x_test) == co.tse(x_test, maxp = 5)$tco, "\n")
```

## 4. Compare Bootstrap Distributions

Both functions should produce identical bootstrap distributions when
using the same `boot_seeds`.

New function without parallel mode mode matches the "old" equivalent
function.

```{r parallel-bootstrap-comparison, cache=TRUE}
# Run wbg.boot.tse (non-legacy mode to get boot_seeds)
result_tse <- wbg.boot.tse(x_test, nb = nb_test, maxp = 5, sn = 123)

# Run wbg.boot.test.tse with SAME boot_seeds
result_parallel_fn <- wbg.boot.test.tse(x_test, stat_fn = stat_fn, nb = nb_test, 
                                         p_max = 5, bootadj = FALSE,
                                         boot_seeds = result_tse$boot_seeds,
                                         parallel = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)

cat("=== Observed Statistic ===\n")
cat("wbg.boot.tse tco:", result_tse$tco, "\n")
cat("wbg.boot.test.tse obs_stat:", result_parallel_fn$obs_stat, "\n")
obs_stat_match <- isTRUE(all.equal(result_tse$tco, result_parallel_fn$obs_stat))
cat("Match:", obs_stat_match, "\n\n")

cat("=== AR Model (Null) ===\n")
cat("wbg.boot.tse p:", result_tse$p, "\n")
cat("wbg.boot.test.tse ar_order:", result_parallel_fn$ar_order, "\n")
ar_order_match <- result_tse$p == result_parallel_fn$ar_order
phi_match <- isTRUE(all.equal(result_tse$phi, result_parallel_fn$ar_phi))
cat("Order match:", ar_order_match, "\n")
cat("Phi match:", phi_match, "\n\n")

cat("=== Bootstrap Distribution ===\n")
cat("First 10 from wbg.boot.tse:\n")
print(head(result_tse$boot_dist, 10))
cat("\nFirst 10 from wbg.boot.test.tse:\n")
print(head(result_parallel_fn$boot_dist, 10))

boot_dist_match <- isTRUE(all.equal(result_tse$boot_dist, 
                                     result_parallel_fn$boot_dist))
cat("\nBootstrap distributions match:", boot_dist_match, "\n")
```

## 5. Compare P-values

P-values differ slightly due to different formulas (+1 correction in new
function).

```{r pvalue-comparison-parallel}
cat("=== P-value Comparison ===\n\n")

cat("wbg.boot.tse p-value:", result_tse$pv, "\n")
cat("wbg.boot.test.tse p-value (two-sided):", result_parallel_fn$pvalue_two, "\n\n")

# Compute both formulas on same bootstrap distribution
pv_old_formula <- mean(abs(result_tse$boot_dist) >= abs(result_tse$tco))
pv_new_formula <- (sum(abs(result_tse$boot_dist) >= abs(result_tse$tco)) + 1) / (nb_test + 1)

cat("Same bootstrap data, different formulas:\n")
cat("  Old formula (mean):", pv_old_formula, "\n")
cat("  New formula (+1 correction):", pv_new_formula, "\n\n")

cat("The +1 correction prevents p-value = 0. \n")
```

## 6. Test Parallel Mode

With `boot_seeds`, parallel mode should produce **identical** results to
sequential.

Equivalent results, thankfully.

```{r parallel-mode-test, cache=TRUE}
cat("=== Parallel vs Sequential (same boot_seeds) ===\n\n")

n_cores <- parallel::detectCores()
if (n_cores > 1) {
  # Run sequential
  result_seq <- wbg.boot.test.tse(x_test, stat_fn = stat_fn, nb = nb_test,
                                   p_max = 5, bootadj = FALSE, seed = 123,
                                   parallel = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
  
  # Run parallel with SAME boot_seeds
  result_par <- wbg.boot.test.tse(x_test, stat_fn = stat_fn, nb = nb_test,
                                   p_max = 5, bootadj = FALSE,
                                   boot_seeds = result_seq$boot_seeds,
                                   parallel = TRUE, num_cpu = 2, verbose = FALSE)
  
  cat("Sequential obs_stat:", result_seq$obs_stat, "\n")
  cat("Parallel obs_stat:", result_par$obs_stat, "\n")
  cat("Observed stat match:", all.equal(result_seq$obs_stat, result_par$obs_stat), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Sequential p-value:", result_seq$pvalue_two, "\n")
  cat("Parallel p-value:", result_par$pvalue_two, "\n")
  pvalue_match <- isTRUE(all.equal(result_seq$pvalue_two, result_par$pvalue_two))
  cat("P-value match:", pvalue_match, "\n\n")
  
  cat("Bootstrap distributions match:", 
      isTRUE(all.equal(result_seq$boot_dist, result_par$boot_dist)), "\n")
  
  parallel_identical <- pvalue_match
  parallel_ran <- TRUE
} else {
  cat("Skipping parallel test - only 1 core available\n")
  parallel_ran <- FALSE
  parallel_identical <- NA
}
```

## 7. Test COBA Adjustment Reproducibility

Booststrap adjustment is reproducible, though still not sure if correct.

```{r coba-test, cache=TRUE}
cat("=== COBA Adjustment Test ===\n\n")

# Run with COBA enabled
result_coba <- wbg.boot.test.tse(x_test, stat_fn = stat_fn, nb = nb_test,
                                  p_max = 5, bootadj = TRUE, seed = 456,
                                  parallel = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

cat("Observed stat:", result_coba$obs_stat, "\n")
cat("Adjusted stat:", result_coba$obs_stat_adj, "\n")
cat("Adjustment factor:", result_coba$adj_factor, "\n\n")

cat("P-value (unadjusted):", result_coba$pvalue_two, "\n")
cat("P-value (COBA adjusted):", result_coba$pvalue_two_adj, "\n\n")

# Reproduce using returned seeds
result_coba2 <- wbg.boot.test.tse(x_test, stat_fn = stat_fn, nb = nb_test,
                                   p_max = 5, bootadj = TRUE,
                                   boot_seeds = result_coba$boot_seeds,
                                   boot_seeds_adj = result_coba$boot_seeds_adj,
                                   parallel = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)

coba_reproducible <- isTRUE(all.equal(result_coba$pvalue_two_adj, 
                                       result_coba2$pvalue_two_adj))
cat("COBA reproducible via seeds:", coba_reproducible, "\n")
```
